g.text: Runtime component layers - V19 menu-stock integration (10 Oct 2026)
Runtime: database/session. Fixtures: explicit demo/tests only.
Shared UserSessionKeys removes the service-to-controller dependency.
Session collaborations use verifier / reader / payment-lookup contracts.
The inspected services use constructor injection; JPA and domain dependencies remain.
Public deployment and Final release still require their own acceptance.
JSON / staff login session / customer cookie
